summary.result: We expect that the study results can provide base data for determining compost types and amount for crop production.
summary.background: The aim of this study was to investigate chemical characteristic of livestock compost in association with livestock manure types (poultry, cattle, swine, and mixed manure).
summary.method: Poultry compost contains greater nutrients especially $P_2O$ (p-value<0.01) and $NH_4$ -N (p-value<0.05).

summary_ko.background: 본 연구는 가축분퇴비의 화학적 특성을 축산동물 분뇨 유형(계란, 소, 돼지, 혼합 분뇨)과 연관하여 분석하기 위한 것이었다.
